'''Sar Labooda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was the sister<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]] member [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]].

==Biography==
Sometime after Sar Labooda's birth, her family left their homeworld, [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]], in order to search the stars for a new home. While traveling, the family's transport was attacked and boarded by a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. With both her parents dead, Labooda and her sister<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> were at the mercy of the scoundrels until, by chance, the esteemed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] appeared and slew the attackers. Discovering the two infants to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Windu took them to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where they were given new names and placed into a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] with other [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]. Growing up separately from each other, both girls passed through the [[Jedi academy|Temple academy]] after completing their [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Trials]]. Ready to become an apprentice, Labooda was selected by a Master to become an apprentice and travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as she continued to study the ways of the Jedi. Crafting for her own use a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and excelling in [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI]] of lightsaber technique, she eventually passed her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]].

When the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] threatened to tear the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in two, Jedi Labooda decided to stand with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yudrish Sedran/Legends|Yudrish Sedran]] of her homeworld in opposition to the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] that proposed the creation of a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to combat the threat of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the act went before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for a vote, the Confederacy's leaders captured Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the senator of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and sentenced them to death by execution. Answering Master Windu's call to form a massive [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to rescue the Jedi and Senator, Labooda was one of 200 Jedi to storm the [[Petranaki arena]] and engage the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. However, her Form VI technique proved insufficient, and she did not survive the ensuing battle.<ref name="Fightsaber" />

==Personality and traits==
Like her sister,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Depa Billaba, Sar Labooda was considered one of the most insightful Jedi of her time. She was very peaceful and was against war.<ref name="Hnn-Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Labooda was a practitioner of Niman and used a green lightsaber. Like many of the Niman users fighting in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], she did not survive.<ref name="Fightsaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character who eventually took the name Sar Labooda was actually intended to be [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]], using a replacement actress when [[Dipika O'Neill Joti]] could not reprise the role. However, the "new" Depa looked dissimilar enough to warrant the creation of a new character.<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|67|Ask Lobot|Star Wars Q&A}}</ref> Due to this, one of the Jedi in [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds#Expansion set: Clone Campaigns|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns'']] present at the Battle of Geonosis is incorrectly identified as Depa Billaba. A similar incident happened with [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], originally intended to be [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], respectively.

The Jedi Master [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]] was also originally named Sar Labooda.
